First Patrol Report.name: First Patrol Report
First Patrol Report.questStatement: Your first patrol has to go on paper, and the paper has to be right: the agency logs every Quirk use, every capture and every yen of property damage, and the Commission audits the numbers. Kamui Woods filed his own account of the morning's call at the station, and his account and yours must match before either report goes in. He has asked you to come to the Agency Offices on Hero Agency Row and settle it.
First Patrol Report.mainObjective: File a complete, accurate report of your first patrol and settle it with Kamui Woods.

completionCondition.query: The PC has filed the report of their first patrol with every Quirk use and capture accounted for, and has squared their account with Kamui Woods', honestly or not.

First Patrol Report.questDesignBrief: Workplace realism with a quiet test of character. Kamui Woods is calm and exact; he cares less about credit than about a correct record, and he notices padding. The mismatch can be an honest error, a lead hero who told the PC to claim the capture, or a Quirk use the PC left out because it broke agency rules. Mount Lady may drift through the Ready Room and make the dispute louder; Sansa Tamakawa can confirm the police side. Failure is paperwork-sized: a reprimand, a docked bonus, and a reputation for sloppy reports that follows the PC along Hero Agency Row. No villain plot surfaces here, and no canon event is staged or foreshadowed.
